text:
Ivy: Whos up for a quick office prediction game for the derby tonight? Loser buys office coffee next week.
Samir: Im dangerously confident. placing a 2-spot on underdog upset.
Tasha: wait are we doing head-to-head or squares?
Noah: Head-to-head bracket would be messy. I say pick winner + final margin.
Marta: I like margin. plus, I want to see the trophies Nina made last month put to good use.
Ivy: Rules: pick winner + margin (1,2,3+). post picks before kickoff.
Samir: Ill take Westbridge by 2.
Tasha: Riverhawks by 1.
Noah: draw is a valid pick? Ill take draw then.
Marta: Riverhawks +3.
OpsBot: Match update scheduled alerts enabled for channel. Kickoff in 30 minutes.
Samir: Also team chant practice at 7pm in kitchen if anyone wants to warm up.
Tasha: Ill bring the cowbell. :(jk) sort of.
Ivy: quick poll: beer or soda for halftime? react with :beer: or :cup_with_straw:.
Samir: :beer:
Noah: :cup_with_straw:
Marta: :beer: (but small cans pls)
Tasha: Also tiny reminder: if youre joining remotely, Ill stream to the channel and paste the link.
Noah: Can we have a worst-pick-of-the-night award? I call it the "Bench Blunder".
Ivy: yes and it comes with a tiny rubber chicken.
Samir: I will accept humiliation in exchange for bragging rights.
OpsBot: Match update  45': Halftime Riverhawks 1 - 0 Westbridge.
Tasha: Halftime snacks: Marta said shell bring homemade empanadas. dangerous levels of delicious.
Marta: Proof: photo incoming (omitted).
Ivy: Live scoreboard: Samir (Westbridge +2), Tasha (Riverhawks +1), Noah (Draw), Marta (Riverhawks +3), Ivy (no pick, humble observer).
Noah: Im sticking with draw. slow and steady.
Samir: This is why you never trust previous form, the league is chaos.
Tasha: Omg what a second-half turnaround would be insane.
OpsBot: Match update  90'+2: Full time Riverhawks 2 - 1 Westbridge.
Ivy: Final results time: Tasha correct (Riverhawks +1). Tasha wins coffee-and-rubber-chicken.
Samir: I paid for two coffees and two apologies.
Noah: Bench Blunder goes to Samir for his bold underdog. (love you)
Marta: Empanadas consumed, celebration complete.
Ivy: Thanks all! Next week: playoff predictions and worst-drama bracket. whos in?
Noah: in. Ill bring the tissues for crying over my fantasy team.
Tasha: count me in. I want to defend my title.
OpsBot: Room "Kitchen" reservation logged 12:00-12:30 for "Derby Debrief & Coffee" organizer: Ivy.
